The number of frames per sub-buffer for synchronous channels. 000 - 1 frame per sub-buffer (Operation is the same as Standard mode) 001 - 2 frames per sub-buffer 010 - 4 frames per sub-buffer 011 - 8 frames per sub-buffer 100 - 16 frames per sub-buffer 101 - 32 frames per sub-buffer 110 - 64 frames per sub-buffer 111 - Reserved Reset Source: prst_n

Control Tx packet retry. When set, a control packet that is flagged with a Break or ProtocolError by the receiver is retransmitted. When cleared, a control packet that is flagged with a Break or ProtocolError by the receiver is skipped. Reset Source: prst_n
Reserved Reset Source: prst_n

Asynchronous Tx packet retry. When set, an asynchronous packet that is flagged with a Break or ProtocolError by the receiver is retransmitted. When cleared, an asynchronous packet that is flagged with a Break or ProtocolError by the receiver is skipped. Reset Source: prst_n
Reserved Reset Source: prst_n

MediaLB lock status. When set, indicates that the MediaLB block is synchronized to the incoming MediaLB frame. If MLBLK is clear (unlocked), MLBLK is set after FRAMESYNC is detected at the same position for three consecutive frames. If MLBLK is set (locked), MLBLK is cleared after not receiving FRAMESYNC at the expected time for two consecutive frames. While MLBLK is set, FRAMESYNC patterns occurring at locations other than the expected one are ignored. (read-only) Reset Source: prst_n
Reserved Reset Source: prst_n
MediaLB 6-pin enable. 0 - MediaLB 3-pin interface enabled 1 - MediaLB 6-pin interface enabled Reset Source: prst_n

MediaLB clock speed select. 000 - 256xFs (for MLBPEN = 0) 001 - 512xFs (for MLBPEN = 0) 010 - 1024xFs (for MLBPEN = 0) 011 - 2048xFs (for MLBPEN = 1) 100 - 3072xFs (for MLBPEN = 1) 101 - 4096xFs (for MLBPEN = 1) 110 - 6144xFs (for MLBPEN = 1) 111 - 8192xFs (for MLBPEN = 1) Reset Source: prst_n
Reserved Reset Source: prst_n
MediaLB enable. When set, MediaLB clock, signal, and data are received and transmitted on the appropriate MediaLB pins. Reset Source: prst_n
Reserved Reset Source: prst_n
MediaLB 6-pin clock hystersis enable. When set, enables hysteresis on the MediaLB clock. This value is driven on mlb_clk_hys_enable output pin and has no internal function. Reset Source: prst_n
Reserved Reset Source: prst_n
MediaLB 6-pin common mode resistor enable. No longer used Reset Source: prst_n
Reserved Reset Source: prst_n

MediaLB channel status. Indicates the channel status for MediaLB channels 31 to 0. Channel status bits are set by hardware and cleared by software. Status is only set if the appropriate bits in the MIEN register are set. Reset Source: prst_n

MediaLB channel status. Indicates the channel status for MediaLB channels 63 to 32. Channel status bits are set by hardware and cleared by software. Status is only set if the appropriate bits in the MIEN register are set. Reset Source: prst_n
Reserved Reset Source: prst_n

Service request enabled. When set, the MediaLB block responds with a 'device present, request service' system response if a matching channel scan system command is detected. When cleared, the MediaLB block responds with a 'device present' system response. Reset Source: prst_n
Sowftware system command detected (in the system quadlet). Set by hardware, cleared by software. Data is stored in the MSD register for this command. Reset Source: prst_n

Channel scan system command detected (in the system quadlet). Set by hardware, cleared by software. If the node address specified in Data quadlet matches the value in MLBC1.NDA, the device responds either 'device present' or 'device present, request service' system response in the next system quadlet. Reset Source: prst_n

Reset system command detected (in the system quadlet). Set by hardware, cleared by software. Reset Source: prst_n

System data (byte 3) - MSB. Updated with MediaLB Data[31:24] when a MediaLB software system command is received in the system quadlet. If MSS.SWSYSCMD is already set, then SD3 is not updated. (read-only) Reset Source: prst_n

System data (byte 2). Updated with MediaLB Data[23:16] when a MediaLB software system command is received in the system quadlet. If MSS.SWSYSCMD is already set, then SD2 is not updated. (readonly) Reset Source: prst_n

System data (byte 1). Updated with MediaLB Data[15:8] when a MediaLB software system command is received in the system quadlet. If MSS.SWSYSCMD is already set, then SD1 is not updated. (read-only) Reset Source: prst_n

System data (byte 0) - LSB. Updated with MediaLB Data[7:0] when a MediaLB software system command is received in the system quadlet. If MSS.SWSYSCMD is already set, then SD0 is not updated. (readonly) Reset Source: prst_n
Reserved (write default value) Reset Source: prst_n
